description: This file defines a static utility class 'TaskSchedulerUtils' containing extension methods for scheduling actions and work items within the Orleans runtime scheduler, focusing on task queuing and execution.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Schedules an action for execution on the specified ActivationTaskScheduler, suppressing the execution context during scheduling.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Schedules a parameterized action with state for execution on the specified ActivationTaskScheduler, suppressing the execution context during scheduling.

methods.name: QueueWorkItem
methods.description: Queues a work item to the specified WorkItemGroup, indirectly scheduling the execution of the work item.

methods.name: QueueWorkItem
methods.description: Queues a work item to the specified IWorkItemScheduler, triggering its execution.
